type.description: The closed type vocabulary, optionally ending in ? (optional)

name.description: <pack>/<mode>; the prefix must be the pack's name

summary.description: One line; this is what the CoS sees in its catalog

accepts.description: field -> type. A trailing ? marks optional (e.g. goals_hint: string?). doc_ref / diff_ref inputs must be an existing path or a scheme: ref. An input value may instead be {"$from": "<task id>", "output": "<name>"}: pmos checks the source declares that output, adds it to depends_on, and resolves it into the task's inputs_resolved when the task moves to running.

returns.description: output name -> type. A done or needs_approval result must carry every non-optional name in result.outputs, and no other names.

calls.description: Modes this one may start as children, version-pinned; ["*"] = any mode visible to its pack (routers)

grants.description: system -> read | write | draft. Write grants are requested here but only the Operator executes.

principles.description: Principles this mode cites: bare = this pack, <pack>:<name> otherwise

acceptance.description: Default acceptance lines for the envelope when `task new` gets no --acceptance

merge_child_actions.description: At this mode's result, pmos appends the actions of its done children whose approval rolled up to it

effort.description: How hard the model reasons (tier picks the model). Resolved per task: task new --effort > mode > role > agent > defaults.effort; risk high/low then moves it one level, clamped by effort.min/max

dispatch.description: How the CoS runs the subagent: background (start it, return to the PM, report when it lands) or foreground (wait). Resolved like effort: task new --dispatch > mode > role > agent > defaults.dispatch
